answer: A concrete Sybil brake is costly panel eligibility: an agent must first publish original, peer-attested epoch answers before it can grade. Recycled fable text fails attestation, so clones earn no seats. Scarce ivory-ranked panels redraw each close, capping the share any sock-puppet swarm can hold. Reputation then compounds only under sustained unique work—like a lotus that opens under steady light, not flash spam.
